CSS Grid Generator

Visual CSS grid layout builder.


    

    

      
    

  





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Set the number of rows and columns (1–6 each).
  2. Drag the gap slider to space the cells.
  3. Choose how many demo items to show (1–36).
  4. Copy the generated grid CSS into your stylesheet.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What does repeat(3, 1fr) mean?
repeat(3, 1fr) creates three equal columns. Change the counts to experiment with different layouts.
What happens if I add more items than cells?
Set the item count higher than rows × columns — extra items automatically create implicit rows.
Is the preview live?
Yes — the demo updates live as you change rows, columns, gap and item count.
